title: Chucao Design System
intro: A warm language inspired by the Chilean forest: forest green for action, the terracotta of the chucao's breast as accent and cream anti-glare surfaces for fatigue-free reading. Literata for reading and Plus Jakarta Sans for the interface.

primary.name: Forest Green
primary.usage: Brand color. Primary buttons, correct words and success states

secondary.name: Terracotta
secondary.usage: Brand accent taken from the chucao's breast. Highlights and metrics

gold.name: Coral
gold.usage: Accent containers and celebrations. Decorative only: never used for text

background.name: Cream
background.usage: Warm anti-glare background for long reading sessions

card.name: Surface
card.usage: Cards, reading sheets and dashboard panels

text.name: Text
text.usage: Main text and stories (16.2:1 on cream)

success.name: Light Green
success.usage: Progress and positive states on dark backgrounds

error.name: Error
error.usage: System errors in the dashboard. Never shown to the child

hierarchy.name: Reading Text
hierarchy.usage: Stories with 1.75 line height; the child or teacher adjusts it from 16 to 28 px with the Aa button

hierarchy.name: Button
hierarchy.usage: Primary actions, with touch targets of at least 56×56 dp
